bull.t: High gross margins and operating profitability
bull.b: Sustained gross margins near 57%–60% and healthy operating profit margins create durable earnings leverage versus revenue, enabling the company to fund R&D and SG&A while absorbing cyclical revenue dips. High structural margins support long-term cash generation and strategic reinvestment.

bull.t: Conservative balance sheet with strong ROE
bull.b: Very low leverage and attractive ROE provide financial flexibility for capex, serial product qualification, buybacks and dividend programs without stressing liquidity. Conservative financing reduces refinancing and solvency risk across semiconductor cycles, supporting steady strategy execution.

bull.t: Robust free cash flow and disciplined capital allocation
bull.b: Consistent positive FCF and a sizable cash balance enable ongoing R&D and demo investment while returning capital via buybacks and dividends. Durable cash conversion underpins flexibility to support multi-year TAM capture and to fund qualification cycles without dilutive financing.

bear.t: Cyclical revenue swings and uneven growth history
bear.b: Historical material revenue volatility reflects end-market capital spending cycles and exposes earnings and cash flow to timing risk. Such cyclicality complicates capacity planning, R&D cadence and investor visibility, and can compress margins and ROE during downturns.

bear.t: Memory-driven margin headwinds and product-mix risk
bear.b: Prolonged lower-margin memory sales and shifting product mix can limit companywide margin expansion even as revenue grows. Persistent memory pressure reduces incremental profitability on new orders and can slow progress toward targeted operating-margin improvements.

bear.t: Working-capital build and qualification/supply timing risk
bear.b: Inventory accumulation to support expected ramps ties up cash and may compress near-term free cash flow if shipments or customer qualifications are delayed. Long qualification cycles, dual-sourcing and supply localization risks can slow durable share gains and prolong cash conversion uncertainty.
